prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1453; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred when the other vehicle, insured under your policy, struck our client while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is pursuing a claim for the damages resulting from it.

Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If our client is contacted by anyone acting on behalf of your company, please refer that person to us.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy under which your insured is covered, along with a copy of the declarations page, within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

Your company is also obligated to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the insured's statements, photographs, vehicle data, recorded communications, claim file materials, and any electronic records. Please take steps now to ensure none of this material is altered, discarded, or lost.
